verdict.rationale: Ironclad has a per-endpoint API reference on its developer hub, covering create/list/retrieve/update/delete webhooks, authentication and the Records and Workflows APIs. It also has guide-style examples, such as launching a workflow via the REST API. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or that examples can be run in-browser, and the OpenAPI spec probe returned 404 on every candidate path. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console, runnable request examples, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration.
